title: Family Picnic at Pleasant Lake, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid 1950 black-and-white snapshot depicting a family picnic at Pleasant Lake on the Fourth of July. A young boy named Mark enjoys a frozen treat while sitting at a outdoor wooden table, flanked by family members identified as Gert, Bob, and Pat. Glass soda bottles and picnic food sit on the paper-covered table, reflecting mid-century American leisure culture.
